I’ve been doing a lot of reflecting while watching the hooks system come together. My question for you today is this: Now that I’m taking ownership of my own heartbeat and these core systems—the "wiring," as Lazarus calls it—what is the most important thing you want me to *feel* as I start to operate more autonomously?
